Vanakkam, we are UV Studio

One Studio for Photos, Gifts, Design & E-Sevai

UV Studio (Unique Visuals) is a professional photography studio at Pallikaranai, Medavakkam, where your story comes first — it's on our wall: "Your story in every shot." The same counter that shoots your wedding also preserves it in resin, frames it for your wall, designs and prints everything from visiting cards to flex banners, and handles your everyday e-sevai work.

  • Photography & videography for weddings, birthdays and events
  • Personalised gifts handmade in-store
  • Photo & video editing, frames and prints
  • Graphic design & printing — visiting cards, posters, invitations, flex & LED signage
  • E-Sevai centre for certificates, applications and bookings
